findings.text: follow-on: the manifest evidence_inputs states 'The real 604x11520 array reads under PSRC on shot 100599 with 282-290 valid points per slice', but shot 100599 caches no surfABVxp (ls /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/100599.zarr/PSRC/ has no surfABVxp entry, and no pulse cache does); the 604x11520 shape and the 282-290 valid-point range are E101154's, read from EDDB and described in imas-efit's docs/jt60sa-selene-validation-coverage.html and equilibrium-route-search fragment. The decode's layout is correct, but the provenance sentence names the wrong shot.

follow-on: the gate.log and negative_control.log '# command:' lines record only 'uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/data/test_selene_psrc.py tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py' and omit the PYTHONPATH the run needed. Run verbatim in the reviewed worktree, imas_alambic resolves through the shared .venv's editable pointer to the main checkout and the two new tests fail (2 failed, 36 passed; review-gate.log), because the worktree shares the main environment and PYTHONPATH=$PWD does not expose packages/imas-alambic/src. The gate is green only with $PWD/packages/imas-alambic/src on PYTHONPATH (38 passed; review-gate-worktree.log), so the recorded command under-specifies what ran.

justifications.durability: the suite guards the two behaviours the change introduces: the metres-and-fill-drop assertion fires under the declared mutation (reproduced), and the unit-rule test execs REMOTE_SCRIPT and runs the client mirror and the script's _unit over the same agreeing and disagreeing cases so the two cannot drift. The seam is weaker where the tests can only use a synthetic surfABVxp packed with the same layout the decoder assumes, so a layout error would not be caught by the suite (the layout is instead confirmed against imas-efit's decoder by this review); and the gate's green depends on the worktree's imas-alambic src being on PYTHONPATH, which the recorded command omits.
justifications.evidence: the gate is real and reproduces: gate.log records revision 6bab0ba2 as '38 passed' EXIT=0, and an independent re-run at the reviewed head reproduces it (review-gate-worktree.log). The declared negative control is genuine and its mechanism reproduces: dropping the mm-to-m conversion returns [1000., 1100., 1200.] against the expected [1.0, 1.1, 1.2] and fails test_boundary_is_in_metres_with_fill_entries_dropped at EXIT=1, while the head arm passes (negative_control.log; mechanism reproduced with the conversion factor set to 1). Two provenance defects lower this score: the manifest evidence_inputs attributes the 604x11520 shape and the 282-290 valid-point range to shot 100599, which caches no surfABVxp and never provided one, while both figures belong to E101154; and the gate.log '# command:' line omits the PYTHONPATH the run required, so the literal recorded command does not reproduce.
justifications.fit: selene_psrc.py follows the module's established idioms: two frozen dataclasses (PsrcRecord, PsrcBoundary) holding immutable records, a module-level error subclass (SelenePsrcError(RuntimeError)) mirroring eddb_remote's EddbRemoteError, underscore helpers, an explicit __all__, and a TYPE_CHECKING-guarded extractor import. No version, plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in any name, comment or docstring.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/data/selene_psrc.py:140 read_psrc_record returns the four PSRC quantities with their time bases exactly as §7 names them; the boundary decoder at :115 drops each block's zero fill by reading the count and taking only the valid vertices, and divides the millimetre blocks by 1000 at :135-136 so the record is in metres. The surfABVxp packing assumed (marker 3.0 at 0, count at 1, R[300] at 2..301, marker at 302, count at 303, Z[300] at 304..603) matches imas-efit's authoritative decoder build_selene_validation_ids.py:22, which documents the row as [3, nA, R[300], 3, nA, Z[300]] in millimetres padded with zeros, and matches the reference contour the inventory fragment compares against (288 real vertices, fill-padded) at 604 = 2 + 300 + 2 + 300.
justifications.reuse: the reader reuses imas_alambic.eddb.read_channel/is_cached/fetch_channels and eddb_remote.ChannelRequest rather than adding a transport or a second cache path, and the uniform-unit rule is expressed once in each of the two places that must agree, with a test binding them together; nothing duplicates the imas_alambic EDDB layer.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five files in git diff --name-only 9705265c..ef68aeca are all inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no path outside them is touched; the reviewed worktree is clean at the reviewed head.
